paper.title: Polynomial Regret Concentration of UCB for Non-Deterministic State Transitions

unmapped: Each arm i leads to one of K_i successor states sampled with fixed probabilities p^i_j; each successor state has its own reward sequence

Reward sequences are non-stationary (possibly history-dependent, as in MCTS subtrees) but their empirical means converge in expectation and satisfy polynomial concentration with constants beta>1, xi>0, 1/2<=eta<1
The learner knows the concentration constants beta, xi, eta (used to set the polynomial UCB bonus and alpha)
Motivated by MCTS/UCT in stochastic-transition planning problems
settings.definition_quote: Let there be $K$ actions the agent can choose from. Each action $i \in [K]$ is connected to $K_i \geq 1$ possible successive states, which are chosen at random. The probability of sampling state $j \in [K_i]$ after choosing action $i\in [K]$ is denoted by $p^i_j\in [0,1]$ ... we assume bounded reward sequences $X^{(i)}_{j,t} \in [-R, R]$ ... we allow the reward sequences to be non-stationary

algorithms.name: UCB with polynomial exploration bonus (UCT-style), with random transitions

bound.regime: for all n >= 1, z >= 1; deviation threshold n^{eta''} z with eta'' = alpha/(xi(1-eta))

symbols.beta_pp: constant beta'' depending on R, K, Delta_min, beta, xi, alpha, eta, K_1..K_K (eq. beta'')
symbols.alpha_ucb: exploration exponent alpha of the polynomial UCB bonus

conditions: leaf reward sequences satisfy convergence and polynomial concentration with constants beta>1, xi>0, 1/2<=eta<1

source.label: thm:main
source.quote: For a non-deterministic, non-stationary MAB satisfying properties 1 (Convergence) and 2 (Concentration), the value $\xbar_n=...$ obtained by applying the presented UCB algorithm with polynomial exploration bonus with appropriate parameter $\alpha > 2$ such that $\xi\eta(1-\eta) \leq \alpha < \xi(1-\eta)$ ... satisfies ... (Concentration): There exist constants $\beta''>1, \xi''>0, \frac{1}{2} \leq \eta'' < 1$ such that ... $\mathbb{P}(n\xbar_n - n\mu_{i*} \geq n^{\eta''}z) \leq \frac{\beta''}{z^{\xi''}}$ ... where $\eta''=\frac{\alpha}{\xi(1-\eta)}$, $\xi''=\alpha-1$

results.notes: Polynomial tail bound on deviation of n*Xbar_n from n*mu_{i*} (a 'regret concentration'); both tails have the same bound. Also states convergence E(Xbar_n) -> mu_{i*}. Quantity mapped to 'other' since it is a tail bound on the deviation of cumulative reward, not a standard regret bound. Environment mapped to nonstationary_drifting as rewards are non-stationary but convergent; no variation budget used.

cited_results.cited_title: Nonasymptotic Analysis of Monte Carlo Tree Search
cited_results.setting_description: Non-stationary K-armed bandit with deterministic transitions, rewards in [-R,R] whose empirical means converge and satisfy polynomial concentration (beta', xi', eta'); tail bound on n*Xbar_n - n*mu_{i*}

bound.regime: n, z >= 1; xi'eta'(1-eta') <= alpha < xi'(1-eta'), alpha > 2
